decision_reason: M1793 passes if it fixes the executable v2 reset-only preflight command and gates without running reset or rollout.
failure_criteria: command or target counts are ambiguous
design ranks profiles or claims paper-level evidence
hypothesis: The full 312-row executable v2 reset-only feasibility preflight can be specified as a fixed command with clear target counts and guardrails.

blocked_by: M1792 implements and tests the v2 reset-feasibility adapter
parent_objective: design the full 312-row executable v2 reset-only feasibility preflight before running it

public_gates: M1793 must fix the exact reset-only command input output target counts and next blocker before execution
